WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date,
        gift_count - goal_amount AS gift_count_minus_goal_amount,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', pledged_date) AS days_since_pledged_date
    FROM volunteer_shifts
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach grant_awards metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(g.volunteer_hrs) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_id) AS min_grant_award_volunteer_hrs,
        (SELECT MAX(g.pledged_on) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_id) AS last_grant_award_pledged_on,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(g.volunteer_hrs), 2) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_id) AS avg_grant_award_volunteer_hrs
    FROM valid s
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    COALESCE(donor_segment, 'ALL') AS donor_segment,
    COALESCE(grant_stage, 'ALL') AS grant_stage,
    campaigns_ch_id,
    MAX(avg_grant_award_volunteer_hrs) AS max_avg_grant_award_volunteer_hrs,
    ROUND(AVG(gift_count), 2) AS avg_gift_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(grant_stage)) AS grant_stage_list
FROM with_stats
GROUP BY ROLLUP(donor_segment, grant_stage, campaigns_ch_id)

WITH filtered_service_tickets AS (
    -- Scope the service_tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE HOUR(drive_started_at) BETWEEN 6 AND 8
),
enriched AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(drive_started_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS drive_started_at_label
    FROM filtered_service_tickets
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(deal_state)) AS deal_state_len,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(fuel_kind), 1, 3) AS fuel_kind_prefix
    FROM enriched
    WHERE deal_state NOT IN ('funded', 'signed')
),
exploded_detail_service_tickets AS (
    -- One row per service_ticket
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.deal_state,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.drive_started_at,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.deal_state_len,
        s.fuel_kind_prefix,
        se.id AS service_ticket_id,
        se.odometer_km AS service_ticket_odometer_km,
        se.fuel_kind AS service_ticket_fuel_kind,
        se.drive_started_at AS service_ticket_drive_started_at,
        se.deal_state AS service_ticket_deal_state
    FROM derived s
    JOIN service_tickets se ON se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref AND se.odometer_km < 162981
)
SELECT
    service_ticket_deal_state,
    service_ticket_fuel_kind,
    service_ticket_id,
    GROUPING(service_ticket_deal_state) AS is_total_service_ticket_deal_state,
    SUM(CASE WHEN service_ticket_deal_state NOT IN ('signed', 'funded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_service_ticket_deal_state_no,
    SUM(deal_state_len) FILTER (WHERE deal_state = 'signed') AS deal_state_len_deal_state_signed,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(service_ticket_fuel_kind)) AS service_ticket_fuel_kind_list
FROM exploded_detail_service_tickets
GROUP BY CUBE(service_ticket_deal_state, service_ticket_fuel_kind, service_ticket_id)
ORDER BY service_ticket_deal_state NULLS LAST, service_ticket_fuel_kind NULLS LAST, service_ticket_id NULLS LAST

WITH scoped_pump_stations AS (
    -- Scope the pump_stations rows
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts,
        street_ref,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(street_ref), ' ', '_')) AS street_ref_slug,
        meter_age_yrs + pressure_bar AS meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar
    FROM pump_stations
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(burst_ts, 'yyyy-MM') AS burst_ts_ym,
        ROUND(AVG(meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar), 2) AS avg_meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS first_burst_ts,
        MAX(pressure_bar) AS max_pressure_bar,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM scoped_pump_stations
    WHERE street_ref_slug IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(burst_ts, 'yyyy-MM')
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM rollup_base
    WHERE distinct_ids < (SELECT MAX(distinct_ids) FROM rollup_base)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    burst_ts_ym,
    avg_meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar,
    max_pressure_bar,
    distinct_ids
FROM screened
WHERE distinct_ids >= 2
ORDER BY burst_ts_ym DESC
LIMIT 10

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scoped_pump_stations = (
    df_pump_stations
    .select(
        "id",
        "station_tier",
        "tariff_band",
        "pressure_bar",
        "meter_age_yrs",
        "burst_ts",
        "street_ref",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("street_ref")), " ", "_")).alias("street_ref_slug"),
        (F.col("meter_age_yrs") + F.col("pressure_bar")).alias("meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    scoped_pump_stations
    .filter(F.col("street_ref_slug").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(F.date_format("burst_ts", "yyyy-MM").alias("burst_ts_ym"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar"), 2).alias("avg_meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar"),
        F.min("burst_ts").alias("first_burst_ts"),
        F.max("pressure_bar").alias("max_pressure_bar"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

screened = (
    rollup_base
    .crossJoin(rollup_base.agg(F.max("distinct_ids").alias("overall_max_distinct_ids")))
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") < F.col("overall_max_distinct_ids"))
    .drop("overall_max_distinct_ids")
)

result = (
    screened
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") >= 2)
    .select(
        "burst_ts_ym",
        "avg_meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar",
        "max_pressure_bar",
        "distinct_ids",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("burst_ts_ym").desc())
    .limit(10)
)

WITH base_finance_deals AS (
    -- Scope the finance_deals rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_year
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE (deal_status IN ('quoted', 'signed') OR UPPER(TRIM(vin_tail)) LIKE 'B%')
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date
    FROM base_finance_deals s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        car_stock_arrived_date,
        LAST_VALUE(car_stock_arrived_date) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date), car_stock_id ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_car_stock_arrived_date,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on_year)) AS rows_in_arrived_on_year_year,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_arrived_on_year_month_deal_s AS rows_in_arrived_on_year_month_deal_status,
        LAST_VALUE(arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) ORDER BY arrived_on_year DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_arrived_on,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(deal_status) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on_year))) AS distinct_deal_status_in_arrived_on_year_year,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date), car_stock_id ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        LAG(odometer_kms) OVER (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id) AS prev_odometer_kms,
        NTH_VALUE(drive_mins, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on), car_stock_body_style ORDER BY arrived_on_year, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_drive_mins,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins) OVER (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS drive_mins_avg_3_prior,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status) AS arrived_on_year_month_deal_status_sum_drive_mins,
        ROUND(odometer_kms / NULLIF(SUM(odometer_kms) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status), 0), 4) AS odometer_kms_share_of_arrived_on_year_month_deal,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(car_stock_body_style) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status)) AS distinct_car_stock_body_style_in_arrived_on_year,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS drive_mins_sum_3_prior,
        SUM(odometer_kms) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS odometer_kms_sum_3_prior
    FROM with_parent
    WINDOW w_arrived_on_year_month_deal_s AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    deal_status,
    drive_mins,
    arrived_on,
    is_certified_used,
    car_stock_arrived_date,
    last_car_stock_arrived_date,
    rows_in_arrived_on_year_year,
    last_arrived_on,
    running_count,
    second_drive_mins,
    drive_mins_avg_3_prior,
    arrived_on_year_month_deal_status_sum_drive_mins,
    odometer_kms_share_of_arrived_on_year_month_deal,
    distinct_car_stock_body_style_in_arrived_on_year,
    drive_mins_sum_3_prior,
    odometer_kms_sum_3_prior,
    DATEDIFF(car_stock_arrived_date, last_arrived_on) AS days_last_arrived_on_to_car_stock_arrived_date
FROM ranked
ORDER BY odometer_kms_sum_3_prior, deal_status DESC NULLS FIRST

        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, tariff_band ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id) AS chlorine_ppm_quintile
    FROM prepared_usage_reads

WITH base_kennels AS (
    -- Scope the kennels rows
    SELECT
        id,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped,
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', groomed_ts) AS groomed_ts_day
    FROM kennels
    WHERE is_microchipped = TRUE
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per species
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM base_kennels
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR groomed_ts > prev_groomed_ts + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        species,
        session_id,
        MIN(groomed_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(visit_cost) AS session_visit_cost,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY species, session_id
)
SELECT species, session_id, metric, reading
FROM (
    SELECT species, session_id, session_visit_cost, duration_min
    FROM session_summary
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric IN (session_visit_cost, duration_min)
) unp

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY mission_state, session_no
)
SELECT
    mission_state,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min,

    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE odometer_km <= 148631
      AND fuel_kind IS NOT NULL
),

    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS odometer_km_sum_7,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at), 3) AS drive_started_at_cume_dist,
        SUM(odometer_km_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_odometer_km_filled,
        ROUND(odometer_km - AVG(odometer_km) OVER w_fuel_kind, 2) AS odometer_km_vs_fuel_kind_avg,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_fuel_kind_by_drive_started_a_3 AS drive_started_at_day_tercile,
        ROUND(AVG(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS odometer_km_avg_4
    FROM base_service_tickets
    WINDOW w_fuel_kind AS (PARTITION BY fuel_kind), w_fuel_kind_by_drive_started_a_3 AS (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id)
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Join showrooms
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.drive_started_at,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.odometer_km_filled,
        s.drive_started_at_day,
        s.odometer_km_sum_7,
        s.drive_started_at_cume_dist,
        s.odometer_km_avg_4,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail,
        sh.odometer_km AS showroom_odometer_km,
        sh.option_tags AS showroom_option_tags
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_ref
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching service_tickets

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter grooming_jobs
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        pet_weight_kg,
        kennel_nights,
        groomed_at,
        CASE WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 14 THEN 'large' WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 7 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS pet_age_yrs_tier
    FROM grooming_jobs
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_at per pet_age_yrs_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_age_yrs_tier ORDER BY groomed_at, id) AS prev_groomed_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_at IS NULL OR groomed_at > prev_groomed_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_age_yrs_tier ORDER BY groomed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        pet_age_yrs_tier,
        session_id,
        MIN(groomed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY pet_age_yrs_tier, session_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE event_count > (SELECT AVG(event_count) FROM session_summary)
)
SELECT
    pet_age_yrs_tier,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    duration_min
FROM without_matches
WHERE session_id < 6
ORDER BY duration_min DESC NULLS FIRST, session_start NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .select(
        "id",

        "pet_weight_kg",
        "kennel_nights",

        F.when(F.col("pet_age_yrs") >= 14, "large").when(F.col("pet_age_yrs") >= 7, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("pet_age_yrs_tier"),
    )
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_groomed_at", F.lag("groomed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("pet_age_yrs_tier").orderBy("groomed_at", "id")))

flagged = (

    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_at").isNull() | (F.col("groomed_at") > F.col("prev_groomed_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

    )
)

without_matches = (
    session_summary
    .crossJoin(session_summary.agg(F.avg("event_count").alias("overall_avg_event_count")))
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > F.col("overall_avg_event_count"))
    .drop("overall_avg_event_count")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .filter(F.col("session_id") < 6)
    .select(
        "pet_age_yrs_tier",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "duration_min",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("duration_min").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("session_start").asc_nulls_last(),
    )

WITH valid AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE (drive_outcome NOT IN ('bought', 'declined') OR car_stock_id IS NOT NULL)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(arrived_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY drive_outcome, deal_status ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_arrived_on,
        MIN(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_on)) AS arrived_on_month_min_drive_mins,
        ROUND(drive_mins - AVG(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_on)), 2) AS drive_mins_vs_arrived_on_month_avg,
        FIRST_VALUE(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY drive_outcome, deal_status ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_drive_mins
    FROM valid
),
with_parent_car_stock AS (
    -- Join car_stock
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.arrived_on,
        s.second_arrived_on,
        s.first_drive_mins,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail,
        sh.signed_on AS showroom_signed_on
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = c.showroom_id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key

        )

    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        showroom_ref,
        is_certified_used_label,
        MIN(odometer_km) AS min_odometer_km
    FROM screened
    GROUP BY showroom_ref, is_certified_used_label
),
combined_details_showroom AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.is_certified_used_label,

        sh.option_tags AS showroom_option_tags,

),
labeled AS (

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped,
        FLOOR(visit_cost / 250) * 250 AS visit_cost_bucket
    FROM kennels
    WHERE visit_cost <= 834.6
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per visit_reason
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR groomed_ts > prev_groomed_ts + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        visit_reason,
        session_no,
        MIN(groomed_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(visit_cost) AS session_visit_cost,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY visit_reason, session_no
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN duration_min >= 168.0 THEN 'A' WHEN duration_min >= 108.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS duration_min_tier,
        CASE WHEN duration_min >= 156.0 THEN 'A' WHEN duration_min >= 60.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS duration_min_tier_2,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month
    FROM per_session
    WHERE visit_reason IN ('injury', 'checkup')
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY duration_min_tier, TO_DATE(session_end) ORDER BY session_start DESC, visit_reason, session_no) AS session_start_seq,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY duration_min_tier, TO_DATE(session_end) ORDER BY session_start DESC), 3) AS session_start_percent_rank,
        MAX(duration_min) OVER (PARTITION BY session_no, duration_min_tier_2) AS session_no_duration_min_tier_2_max_duration_min,
        LAG(session_end, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY duration_min_tier, TO_DATE(session_end) ORDER BY session_start DESC, visit_reason, session_no) AS prev2_session_end,
        SUM(events) OVER (PARTITION BY session_no, duration_min_tier_2) AS session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    visit_reason,
    session_no,
    MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start,
    SUM(session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events) AS total_session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events,
    SUM(session_start_percent_rank) AS total_session_start_percent_rank
FROM with_trends
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((visit_reason, session_no), (visit_reason))
ORDER BY visit_reason NULLS LAST, session_no NULLS LAST

    FROM pledges

annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        days_since_awarded_date,
        CASE WHEN cause_area IN ('education', 'climate') THEN 'group_a' WHEN cause_area = 'animals' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS cause_area_group,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) AS awarded_date_month
    FROM base
    WHERE pledge_amount < 22932.3
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM annotated
    WHERE pledge_amount > (SELECT AVG(pledge_amount) FROM annotated)
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE days_since_awarded_date > (SELECT AVG(days_since_awarded_date) FROM without_matches)
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM with_activity
    WHERE pledge_amount < (SELECT MAX(pledge_amount) FROM with_activity)
),

    FROM pump_stations

),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous burst_ts per station_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(burst_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id) AS prev_burst_ts
    FROM prepared_pump_stations
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_burst_ts IS NULL OR burst_ts > prev_burst_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        station_tier,
        session_no,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(burst_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(burst_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(burst_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY station_tier, session_no
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        session_no,
        TO_DATE(session_start) AS session_start_day,
        ROUND(SUM(event_count) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_min), 0), 3) AS event_count_to_duration_min_ratio,
        SUM(event_count) AS total_event_count,
        SUM(session_no) FILTER (WHERE station_tier = 'reserve') AS session_no_station_tier_reserve,
        MIN(session_end) AS first_session_end
    FROM session_summary
    GROUP BY session_no, TO_DATE(session_start)
    HAVING SUM(duration_min) > 48.0
)

    session_no,
    session_start_day,
    event_count_to_duration_min_ratio,

    first_session_end,
    ADD_MONTHS(session_start_day, 1) AS session_start_day_plus_1m,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', first_session_end) AS days_since_first_session_end
FROM rollup_base

WITH scoped_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        mission_name,
        ABS(frame_seq - 2870) AS frame_seq_distance,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', frame_at) AS days_since_frame_at
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE mission_id >= 14
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(mission_name), 1, 2) AS mission_name_prefix,
        CONCAT(mission_name, '#', CAST(frame_seq AS STRING)) AS mission_name_ref
    FROM scoped_telemetry_frames
),
filtered AS (
    -- Rows that have matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payload_items p
            WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND p.payload_kg <= 17841.0
        )
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(t.frame_at) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS first_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM filtered s
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per mission_id
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        mission_name,
        frame_seq_distance,
        days_since_frame_at,
        mission_name_prefix,
        mission_name_ref,
        first_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY days_since_frame_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM with_stats
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_mission_id_by_frame_seq_dist AS frame_seq_distance_rank,
        ROUND(days_since_frame_at - AVG(days_since_frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, YEAR(first_telemetry_frame_frame_at)), 2) AS days_since_frame_at_vs_mission_id_first_telemetr,
        LAST_VALUE(days_since_frame_at) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_distance NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_days_since_frame_at
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_mission_id_by_frame_seq_dist AS (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_distance NULLS LAST, id)
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.payload_kind = 'probe') FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN t.mission_state = 'partial' THEN 1 END) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS telemetry_frame_mission_state_count
    FROM with_trends s
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM with_counts
    WHERE frame_seq_distance < (SELECT MAX(frame_seq_distance) FROM with_counts)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    burn_secs,
    frame_seq_distance,
    mission_name_prefix,
    mission_name_ref,
    first_telemetry_frame_frame_at,
    frame_seq_distance_rank,
    days_since_frame_at_vs_mission_id_first_telemetr,
    telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
    telemetry_frame_count,
    telemetry_frame_mission_state_count,
    frame_seq_distance_rank + days_since_frame_at AS frame_seq_distance_rank_plus_days_since_frame_at
FROM with_activity

),

        MAX(awarded_date_month) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) ORDER BY donor_pledge_amt, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS awarded_date_month_max_6_prior,

WITH valid AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', deal_state, fuel_kind) AS deal_state_fuel_kind_label
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE (HOUR(drive_started_at) BETWEEN 9 AND 14 OR deal_state IN ('quoted', 'signed'))
),
deal_state_stats AS (
    -- Median odometer_km per deal_state
    SELECT deal_state, PERCENTILE_APPROX(odometer_km, 0.5) AS median_odometer_km
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY deal_state
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_odometer_km,
        ROUND(s.odometer_km - g.median_odometer_km, 2) AS odometer_km_minus_median
    FROM valid s
    JOIN deal_state_stats g ON g.deal_state = s.deal_state
    WHERE s.odometer_km >= g.median_odometer_km
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    COALESCE(deal_state, 'ALL') AS deal_state,
    showroom_ref,
    is_certified_used,

without_matches AS (

    FROM without_matches s
    JOIN mission_mission_state_stats g ON g.mission_mission_state = s.mission_mission_state
    WHERE s.frame_seq >= g.median_frame_seq

WITH recent AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        TRUNC(arrived_on, 'MM') AS arrived_on_month_start,
        COALESCE(drive_mins, 0) AS drive_mins_filled
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_mins > 25
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching finance_deals
    SELECT s.*
    FROM recent s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM finance_deals f
            WHERE f.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
              AND f.deal_status IN ('signed', 'funded')
              AND f.drive_mins >= 37
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per car_stock_id
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        arrived_on_month_start,
        drive_mins_filled
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM with_activity
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(drive_mins_filled - AVG(drive_mins_filled) OVER w_arrived_on_month_start_month, 2) AS drive_mins_filled_vs_arrived_on_month_start_mont,
        SUM(drive_mins_filled) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS drive_mins_filled_sum_7,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_drive_mins_filled AS drive_mins_filled_seq,
        DATEDIFF(arrived_on_month_start, LAG(arrived_on_month_start) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id)) AS days_since_prev_arrived_on_month_start,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST) AS drive_mins_filled_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins_filled) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS drive_mins_filled_avg_7
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_arrived_on_month_start_month AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_on_month_start), car_stock_id), w_all_by_drive_mins_filled AS (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
car_stock_id_stats AS (
    -- Median drive_mins_filled_seq per car_stock_id
    SELECT car_stock_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(drive_mins_filled_seq, 0.5) AS median_drive_mins_filled_seq
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_drive_mins_filled_seq,
        ROUND(s.drive_mins_filled_seq - g.median_drive_mins_filled_seq, 2) AS drive_mins_filled_seq_minus_median
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN car_stock_id_stats g ON g.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
    WHERE s.drive_mins_filled_seq >= g.median_drive_mins_filled_seq
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per car_stock_id
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        arrived_on_month_start,
        drive_mins_filled,
        drive_mins_filled_vs_arrived_on_month_start_mont,
        drive_mins_filled_sum_7,
        drive_mins_filled_seq,
        days_since_prev_arrived_on_month_start,
        drive_mins_filled_rank,
        drive_mins_filled_avg_7,
        median_drive_mins_filled_seq,
        drive_mins_filled_seq_minus_median
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins_filled_avg_7, id) AS row_num
        FROM compared
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    deal_status,
    arrived_on_month_start,
    drive_mins_filled,
    drive_mins_filled_vs_arrived_on_month_start_mont,
    drive_mins_filled_sum_7,
    drive_mins_filled_rank,
    drive_mins_filled_avg_7,
    median_drive_mins_filled_seq,
    drive_mins_filled_seq_minus_median
FROM unique_rows
WHERE days_since_prev_arrived_on_month_start BETWEEN 60 AND 160
ORDER BY arrived_on_month_start DESC, drive_mins_filled_rank NULLS LAST

WITH quoted_by_car_stock AS (

    SELECT car_stock_id, COUNT(*) AS quoted_count, SUM(odometer_kms) AS quoted_total_odometer_kms
    FROM finance_deals

)

SELECT

    COALESCE(a.quoted_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.signed_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM quoted_by_car_stock a
FULL OUTER JOIN signed_by_car_stock b
  ON a.car_stock_id = b.car_stock_id

        is_certified_used
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind = 'diesel'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous drive_started_at per deal_state
    SELECT *, LAG(drive_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_state ORDER BY drive_started_at, id) AS prev_drive_started_at
    FROM cleaned_service_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_drive_started_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(drive_started_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_drive_started_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_state ORDER BY drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(drive_started_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_drive_started_at,
        MAX(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS is_new_session_max_1_prior,
        RANK() OVER w_drive_started_at_month_sessi_3 AS prev_drive_started_at_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        ROUND(odometer_km - AVG(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_state, is_certified_used), 2) AS odometer_km_vs_deal_state_is_certified_used_avg
    FROM sessionized
    WINDOW w_drive_started_at_month_sessi_3 AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at)
),
screened AS (

    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s

            WHERE se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref

WITH valid_service_tickets AS (

        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', fuel_kind, deal_state) AS fuel_kind_deal_state_label,
        CASE WHEN deal_state IN ('signed', 'quoted') THEN 'group_a' WHEN deal_state = 'funded' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS deal_state_group
    FROM service_tickets

        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        ROUND(AVG(odometer_km), 2) AS avg_odometer_km
    FROM valid_service_tickets

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)

FROM (

    FROM totals
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric IN (n_rows, max_odometer_km, total_odometer_km)
) unp

WITH ev_by_showroom_ref AS (
    -- ev rows per showroom_ref
    SELECT showroom_ref, COUNT(*) AS ev_count, SUM(odometer_km) AS ev_total_odometer_km
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind = 'ev'
    GROUP BY showroom_ref
),
petrol_by_showroom_ref AS (
    -- petrol rows per showroom_ref
    SELECT showroom_ref, COUNT(*) AS petrol_count, ROUND(AVG(odometer_km), 2) AS petrol_avg_odometer_km
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind = 'petrol'
    GROUP BY showroom_ref
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.showroom_ref, b.showroom_ref) AS showroom_ref,
    COALESCE(a.ev_count, 0) AS ev_count,
    a.ev_total_odometer_km,
    COALESCE(b.petrol_count, 0) AS petrol_count,
    COALESCE(b.petrol_avg_odometer_km, 0) AS petrol_avg_odometer_km,
    COALESCE(a.ev_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.petrol_count, 0) AS ev_count_minus_petrol_count
FROM ev_by_showroom_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN petrol_by_showroom_ref b
  ON a.showroom_ref = b.showroom_ref
ORDER BY showroom_ref

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        CASE WHEN frame_seq >= 7279 THEN 'A' WHEN frame_seq >= 2958 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS frame_seq_tier
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per payload_kind
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY payload_kind ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(frame_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_frame_at)) / 60 > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY payload_kind ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        payload_kind,
        burst_id,
        MIN(frame_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(frame_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(frame_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(frame_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY payload_kind, burst_id
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    burst_id,
    events,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    SUM(burst_id) FILTER (WHERE payload_kind = 'sat') AS burst_id_payload_kind_sat,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payload_kind IN ('sat', 'crew', 'cargo') THEN events ELSE 0 END) AS events_payload_kind_in_sat_crew_car
FROM sessions
GROUP BY CUBE(burst_id, events)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_telemetry_frames
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_id",
        "mission_state",
        "payload_kind",
        "frame_seq",
        "burn_secs",
        "frame_at",
        "mission_name",
        F.when(F.col("frame_seq") >= 7279, "A").when(F.col("frame_seq") >= 2958, "B").otherwise("C").alias("frame_seq_tier"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_frame_at", F.lag("frame_at").over(Window.partitionBy("payload_kind").orderBy("frame_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_frame_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("frame_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_frame_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("payload_kind").orderBy("frame_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("payload_kind", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("frame_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("frame_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("frame_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("frame_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .cube("burst_id", "events")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("payload_kind") == "sat", F.col("burst_id"))).alias("burst_id_payload_kind_sat"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("payload_kind").isin("sat", "crew", "cargo"), F.col("events")).otherwise(0)).alias("events_payload_kind_in_sat_crew_car"),
    )
)
